summary: S&P 500 fell 0.38% to 7,337.11 on May 7 after hitting intraday ATH. Dow shed 313 points (-0.63%) to 49,596.97. Nasdaq slid 0.13% to 25,806. Iran ceasefire breach rattled markets. Nvidia, MSFT, TSLA led tech gains. AMD +17.77% and Supermicro +24.5% on earnings beat drove semis higher on May 6. Markets pulled back from record highs set May 6.
